versions.changelog: Fix small screen size description: 7.5 inch → 7.3 inch
Add homepage link, require explicit user consent before BLE scans and token usage, rename CLI to bloomin8_cli.py
Switch API base URL from dev to production server
clarify cache matching logic: name+IP uses name lookup (recommended), IP-only uses IP lookup with DHCP warning
local-first mode selection, troubleshooting decision tree, --ip cache lookup by IP, upstream marked as advanced, one-liner dependency check
Enforce JPEG baseline + exact screen-size output; abort upload when screen size unknown; add image sourcing guidance and device format constraints to SKILL.md; remove unused image_utils.py
Fix: cmd_info missing subscribe_notifications and getInfo command, causing info retrieval to always timeout

Add local BLE + LAN mode: scan nearby devices, get device info, upload images with instant display. Bundled Python CLI scripts (eink_cli.py, image_utils.py). Device identity bridging across cloud and local modes via device name.
Token management no longer requires remote push enabled; push/cancel/interval endpoints now document remote_image_on requirement
Initial release: push images/markdown to e-ink frames, check status, track delivery, change wake schedule
